findings.title: Two spec ACs verified by a substituted method
findings.disposition_rationale: Load came from concurrent copies of the test case, not busy-loop processes, because the auto-mode safety check refused synthetic CPU load; no local Node 20, so the Node 20 leg relies on the CI unit shards, which faff merge-gate requires green. Recorded on the ticket as a decision. Action: post that decision on FAFF-1202.

findings.title: the lock-exists assertion is a point-in-time check that can false-pass on a takeover-and-crash path
findings.refutation: The takeover-and-crash path needs a stale takeover first, which cannot happen: the seeded mtime is 60s in the future, so fs-lock.js sees a negative age for the whole 30s wait. A successful takeover would log abort-actioned, which the retained doesNotMatch assertion catches.
findings.disposition_rationale: The existsSync assertion guards the realistic stale-takeover-then-release regression; the ledger byte-identity suggestion is a further belt-and-braces check outside the spec, not a gap.
